base_reason: Keep the measured 39070273796 build on the first-parent chain used by select-qwen-container.sh. This branch inherits its exact kernel and SGLang patches; only Aspire runtime wiring changes.

aspire_reference.config_comparison: Only container_sha256 and prefill_expert_location differ from d7ade0e. Preserve P2/D2, TP4/DP4/EP4, c104, EAGLE3 steps3/draft4, FP8 KV, Prefill round_robin, H100 pools, graph buckets and memory fractions.

changes: Reuse the exact measured image containing the Decode N_SWAP hoist, FC1 quantizer and dispatch pull overlap patches.
Stage the same 94-layer / 128-expert permutation and mount it read-only for both Prefill workers. Decode retains trivial placement.
Validate static dispatch and placement on the top-level endpoint and all four DP states per worker, in addition to existing H100 KV-capacity checks.

target.assessment: Target only, not a prediction. Aspire c104 is Prefill-limited with no measured ITL violations; static expert placement addresses that bottleneck. Firmus improvements include Decode SLA recovery and cannot be applied proportionally to H100. No throughput claim without a new Aspire run.
